description: Search Google Patents or fetch full patent records. Pick a mode and fill the matching fields.

assignees.description: Assignee or applicant names. The actor runs one search per name.
assignees.title: Assignees / companies

citationDepth.description: How many citation hops to follow in byCitation mode: 1, 2 or 3.
citationDepth.title: Citation depth

citationDirection.description: Which side of the citation graph to walk in byCitation mode.
citationDirection.title: Citation direction

classifications.description: CPC codes or prefixes such as H04L9/06, G06N3/00, H01M10. Combined with a keyword query when both are set.
classifications.title: CPC classifications

countryCodes.description: Two-letter office codes: US, EP, WO, JP, CN, KR, DE, GB, FR, CA, AU, IN and more. Empty means all offices.
countryCodes.title: Patent offices

dateFrom.description: Earliest date, inclusive. Leave empty for no lower bound.
dateFrom.title: Date from (YYYY-MM-DD)

dateTo.description: Latest date, inclusive. Leave empty for no upper bound.
dateTo.title: Date to (YYYY-MM-DD)

dateType.description: Which date the From and To fields apply to.
dateType.title: Date field

detailLanguage.description: Language of the patent page text. Google translates where available.
detailLanguage.title: Detail page language

documentLanguages.description: Original publication languages: ENGLISH, GERMAN, FRENCH, SPANISH, JAPANESE, KOREAN, CHINESE, RUSSIAN, PORTUGUESE, ITALIAN, ARABIC, DUTCH, SWEDISH, FINNISH, NORWEGIAN, DANISH. This filters documents; it does not translate them.
documentLanguages.title: Document languages

fetchFullDetails.description: For search modes, also fetch each patent page for claims, legal status, citations, family and other detail fields.
fetchFullDetails.title: Fetch full details

grouping.description: One row per patent family (Google's default) or one row per publication.
grouping.title: Result grouping

includeNonPatentLiterature.description: Also return Google Scholar non-patent literature rows for each keyword query.
includeNonPatentLiterature.title: Include non-patent literature

includeSimilar.description: Google mixes similar documents into search results. Keep them (label matchType=similar) or drop them.
includeSimilar.title: Include similar documents

inventors.description: Inventor names. The actor runs one search per name.
inventors.title: Inventors

litigation.description: Only patents with related litigation, only patents with no known litigation, or any.
litigation.title: Litigation filter

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. Google Patents exposes about 1,000 results per query; use date, office or CPC filters to go deeper.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxItemsPerQuery.description: Optional cap for each query / inventor / assignee / CPC search. 0 means only the global Max items cap applies.
maxItemsPerQuery.title: Max items per query

publicationNumbers.description: Publication numbers such as US11704715B2, EP3789012A1, WO2020012345A1. Used by byPatent, byCitation and byFamily.
publicationNumbers.title: Publication numbers

searchQueries.description: One or more keyword queries. Google Patents syntax works: quoted phrases, OR, minus, TI=(title words), CL=(claim words), CPC=H04L9/06.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

sortBy.description: Google's relevance, newest first, or oldest first.
sortBy.title: Sort order

status.description: Any status, granted patents only, or published applications only.
status.title: Grant status

urls.description: Patent pages (/patent/US.../en) or search pages (/?q=...&assignee=...&country=...). All search filters in the URL are honoured.
urls.title: Google Patents URLs

title: Google Patents Scraper Input
